newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani bourse chief hails package to cut taxes.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani bourse chief hails package to cut taxes.

text.p: Pakistan's main stock exchange in Karachi on Friday welcomed an economic reforms package announced by the government and said its overall impact would be positive on industry.
"The overall impact of lower taxes as proposed by the Finance Minister (Sartaj Aziz) will be positive," said Arif Habib, president of the Karachi Stock Exchange.
Habib said the cuts in corporate taxes, general sales tax and income taxes would boost profits of companies that could assist the stock market.

The package, announced by Finance Minister Sartaj Aziz, included cuts in the maximum import tariff to 45 percent from the existing 65 percent, except for automobiles, and in general sales tax and personal income tax.
At the end of Aziz's speech, the KSE 100-share index closed up 6.74 points, or 0.42 percent, at 1,620.12. Gainers led losers 107 to 103.
